about: What the night proposes: the list and its badge, the member's word (adopt, dismiss, rename), coming back on one put away, merging, cutting a part out, a proposal's page. Only the proposals' own routes are compared: what each app re-reads after an adoption differs by design (iOS the conversations, Android the domains; see the report).
ios: Maurice/Services/ChatService.swift — loadProposals, markProposalsSeen, applyProposals, restoreProposal, mergeProposals, splitProposal, proposalDetail
android: core/domains/DomainStore.kt — loadProposals, markProposalsSeen, apply, restore, merge, split, proposal
